'''Vedain''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]]<ref name="CCG" /> who worked as a skiff [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Biography==
Vedain's family sold him to Jabba as a slave. He was a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with other [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]].<ref name="CCG" /> He piloted the sail [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] carrying Jabba's prisoners to be executed at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]<ref name="RotJ" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> After [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], one of the prisoners, obtained his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who was disguised as a skiff guard himself, attacked Vedain. The two struggled until knocked overboard by a shot from one of the cannons on board [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], Jabba's [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] [[Luxury-class sail barge|Luxury sail barge]]. Lando managed to grab onto the skiff as they fell keeping somewhat safely away from the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc's]] mouth while Vedain fell to the ground sliding right towards it.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vedain was played uncredited<ref name="RotJ" /> by stuntman [[Paul Weston]]<ref name="Actor">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2014/09/behind-scenes-just-another-day-at-skiff.html|name=STAR WARS AFICIONADO WEBSITE|text=Behind the Scenes: Just Another Day at the Skiff!}}</ref> in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="RotJ" />
